MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The reusable cable straps fit my ongoing desk organization: I've bought cable covers, cable ties and a headphone mount, and reusable straps would make later equipment changes easier.",
    "The Ethernet switch feels like a natural extension of my recent Ethernet adapter and patch cables because it would let me connect more devices by wire.",
    "The portable drive fits my broader computer use by offering space for backups and files across devices, although that need is less explicit in my recent purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HDMI cable doesn't solve a current problem: I already bought one and haven't shown a need for extra length.",
    "A USB extension and a printer-style USB-B cable serve different purposes; buying the extension doesn't mean I have a device needing the other connector.",
    "Both memory kits require a compatible computer and an actual upgrade need, neither of which my laptop accessories establish.",
    "Headphones don't give me a use for speaker-wire plugs, and a drive carrying case needs a specific drive to fit. The streaming stick also feels disconnected from my current computer maintenance needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat cables as interchangeable needs, even though connector type, length and the equipment being connected determine whether I'd use them.",
    "Owning computer accessories seems to be taken as a reason to recommend memory upgrades, while owning headphones seems to imply a broader speaker setup. Those purchases don't establish those needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchases point toward organizing, cleaning and improving wired connections around my existing setup; useful additions to those tasks feel more relevant right now.",
    "It matters whether an item complements equipment I already have, duplicates something I've bought, or requires hardware I haven't indicated owning.",
    "Compatibility and fit matter before I'd choose memory or a carrying case; a broadly related accessory isn't enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my effort to maintain and organize my computer setup, but sometimes confused related electronics with equipment I currently need."
}
